messages:
alex: Follow-up from the incident postmortem: we need a practical rollout safety spec we can ship this sprint. Key goals: cohort-aware auto-rollback, staged ramps, and per-flag blast-radius limits. Owners + ETAs by EOD tomorrow please.

mona: OK. We should pick exact signals and threshold semantics so the rollout controller is testable.

raj: Recommend pairing infra health (5xx) with business-impact (checkout failures). Latency alone is too noisy. Also ensure evaluation happens at cohort level (region/user_bucket).

alex: Draft spec: ramp [1,10,50]%, min_stage 30m. Auto-rollback if both conditions met in same cohort: http_5xx_rate > 2.5% over 5m AND checkout_failure_rate > 0.5% over 5m. Add blast_radius_cap applied for first 72h.

sam: For platform-critical flags (payments, auth) set default blast_radius_cap=20%. Any raise needs SRE signoff + validated canary.

mona: Quick config example for the rollout controller:

```
flag: payments_v2
ramp_pct: [1,10,50]
min_stage: 30m
auto_rollback:
  require_all: true
  conditions:
    - metric: http_5xx_rate
      threshold: 2.5
      window: 5m
    - metric: checkout_failure_rate
      threshold: 0.5
      window: 5m
blast_radius_cap_pct: 20
cohort_eval: true
```

raj: Implementation notes: cohort_eval must match analytics cohort keys. Also run a synthetic canary check before each stage transition and count failures towards rollback.

alex: Action items: 1) mona implement rollout-controller + unit tests (owner: mona, ETA: 2025-07-01). 2) raj add cohort aggregation and canary harness + dashboards (owner: raj, ETA: 2025-06-27). 3) sam draft blast-radius policy, exception flow, and docs (owner: sam, ETA: 2025-06-29). I will own a 48h validation after first rollout.

ops-bot: INC-2025-043 follow-ups assigned: [mona, raj, sam]. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2025-043

sam: Acknowledged. Will include sample dashboards and escalation playbook.

mona: Will open a draft PR and tag canary infra for review.

alex: Thanks all  reconvene Fri 9am to review PRs and pick safe defaults.
